'''Daw Sembian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[weaponsmith]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was the father of [[Vil Sembian]]. When he [[Death/Legends|died]], he left his son a schematic for a new type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] which could tip the scales in the Galactic Civil War.

==Biography==
Daw Sembian was the father of [[Vil Sembian]]. He was also a famous [[weaponsmith]] who created a schematic for a new type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] which could tip the scales in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Daw died some time prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], but left the schematics for the blaster to his son.<ref name="SWG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Vil Sembian headed to [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to deliver the schematics to his friend, a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] named [[Nitra Vendallan]].<ref name="SWG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
However, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] was on his tail, so Nitra Vendallan sent a Rebel [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to find Vil and bring him back safely to [[City/Legends|town]]. Despite facing resistance from Imperial forces, the spacer succeeded in escorting Vil. Vendallan was pleased, and saw to it that the schematics made it to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]].<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Daw Sembian was a character briefly mentioned in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Players who performed a series of quests for [[Nitra Vendallan]] in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] learned that Daw Sembian was a famous [[weaponsmith]] who created the schematics for a new type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="SWG" />
